function show(): void {
  const Symbol = { name: "value" as const, method: "read" as const };
  const original = { [Symbol.name]: 1, [Symbol.method]() { return 2; } };
  const typed: { [Symbol.name]: number; [Symbol.method](): number } = original;
  class Example {
    [Symbol.name] = 3;
    [Symbol.method]() { return 4; }
  }
  const instance = new Example();
  console.log(original.value, typed.read(), instance.value, instance.read());
}
show();
console.log([...new Set([1, 2])]);
